text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've been training together with Trainer
just for this day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make these well-trained hamstrings roar at full blast!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
B-But will she really be okay~!?
Her muscles might be fine, but her spirit
looks like it's about to wither away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My debut race... Everyone else is going to come carrying so many hopes and dreams, too, uuuu...

*sigh* I had a feeling that was the case.
Ryan-chan, you're just way too nice.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The other girls are carrying a lot on their shoulders too,
and the same goes for Ryan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan's dream isn't just hers alone anymore, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Your Trainer and I, your roommate, are rooting for you with all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I've got people cheering for me
just as hard, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Giving it my all for someone else's sake...
Thinking about it that way makes me feel a bit more at ease!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I have to do this, I have to see it through.
In my own way—Make Debut!!
